purpose: Provision or reconcile the Local, Development and Production runtime identities without moving secrets into source control.

actions: read local.worker, local.domain and local.database from starter.config.json
ensure the named Cloudflare Tunnel reaches local.database.host:local.database.port
ensure the corresponding Workers VPC service is available for the selected test database
keep the local URL on localhost and never attach it to the production Worker
ensure the Development Worker exists with the configured name
ensure the configured Development domain and route point to that Worker
ensure its database and Hyperdrive/VPC binding match the Development configuration
ensure the Production Worker exists with the configured name
ensure the configured Production domain and route point to that Worker
ensure its database and Hyperdrive/VPC binding match the Production configuration

rules: Read values from starter.config.json; do not invent names or IDs.
Never read, print or commit secret values.
Do not use Production resources for Local or Development tests.
Record actual Cloudflare resource IDs and verification results in the local ignored receipt after execution.
Do not claim configured until Tunnel, Worker, route and database binding checks succeed.
